profile.headline: Engineering @ Breezeway
profile.summary:
I am a backend software engineer and a graduate of Hackbright Academy's Software Engineering Fellowship.

Languages: Python, Java, JavaScript (Node.js)
Frameworks, databases, etc: Flask, FastAPI, Dropwizard, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLAlchemy, AWS tooling (SQS, ECS, RDS, CloudWatch, etc), Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes

positions.title: Backend Engineer
positions.description:
I was part of the FlowBuilder team; we owned the creation and execution of marketing automations and campaigns.

Main technologies used: Python/Flask, PostgreSQL, SQS, ECS, ElastiCache (Redis)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I was part of the Connectivity Engineering team that was responsible for external integrations. I also spent part of my time as a guest engineer on the Platform Architecture team.

Main technologies used: Python/Flask, Python/FastAPI, JavaScript (Node.js), PostgreSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I was part of the Identity and Access Management team that was responsible for authentication, authorization, and general IAM across the company for all its products.

Main technologies used: Java, Dropwizard, MySQL, Python

positions.title: Software Engineering Apprentice
positions.description: Main technologies used: Java, Dropwizard, MySQL, Python, Flask

positions.title: Software Engineering Fellow
positions.description: Studied computer science fundamentals and modern web development. Conceptualized, designed, and built a full-stack web application as a capstone project.

positions.title: Graduate Assistant
positions.description:
Instructed General Organic Chemistry recitations for more than 100 university sophomores per semester.

Reinforced and taught fundamental organic chemistry concepts.

company.name: University of the Sciences in Philadelphia

projects.title: Food Trends
projects.description:
Created a web application that discovers popular ingredient pairings in the blogosphere.

Conceptualized, designed and implemented a fully-featured web application from the ground up.

Tackled new technologies: Python for web development, Flask, and SQLAlchemy.

projects.title: Titanic: Machine Learning from Disaster
projects.description:
This project is an analysis of and deployment of a machine learning algorithm on the "Titanic: Machine Learning from Disaster" dataset from Kaggle.com.

Used Python to 1) discover which passenger characteristics correlate with survival and 2) create and use a machine learning algorithm to predict survival rates on novel data points.

publications.title: Efficient NMR enantiodiscrimination of bridge fluorinated paracyclophanes using lanthanide tris β-diketonate complexes
